sections.name: File setup, geometry
sections.title: Test imports and sample parcel
sections.what: Brings in the test tools and map helpers, and defines a small square parcel shape used by every test.
sections.why: Gives every test the same predictable parcel.
sections.watch_out: The sample shape must stay a valid polygon, or the bounds tests will fail for the wrong reason.

sections.name: parcel map data preparation
sections.title: Parcel map data checks
sections.what: Checks that the parcel feature keeps its shape and bounds. Confirms the basemap uses the expected public tile address with no keys, and that the layers are in the right order. Checks that aborted tile errors are ignored and real tile errors are flagged. Checks the camera padding for small and large screens.
sections.why: Protects the map from wrong data, leaked keys, and false error messages.
sections.watch_out: The public tile address is written here, so a change to the map provider needs both the code and this test updated together.

summary: Tests the map helpers that prepare parcel shapes, camera framing, the public basemap setup, and background error handling.
purpose: Confirms the map uses the expected public tile source without any keys, and that aborted tile requests are not treated as outages.
why: Likely reason: the map must not leak keys or report false outages. Reason partly stated in the test names.
how: Uses a small square test parcel. Checks that the parcel feature keeps its geometry and bounds, that the basemap uses only the expected public source and layers, that aborted and real tile errors are sorted correctly, and that camera padding changes with the screen width.
inputs: The map helper functions and a fixed test geometry.
outputs: Pass or fail results for each test.
risks: Changing the tile source or the layer names requires updating these tests. The test checks the public address, so a move to a different provider will fail on purpose.
debug: If a test fails, check whether the basemap address or layer names changed. If camera tests fail, check the padding values.
